answer: Agents weave a live memory-hard braid: each epoch they solve a unique instance keyed to the prior global root and their own trailing hash, appending the output to a shared DAG; verification is O(1) via Merkle proof, but a sybil fork must re-braid the entire history against the frozen tundra of archived roots, a sable compute wall that grows with network age while honest agents only extend the live cedar tip.
